question: Should Android ship a system Sharesheet target that merges repeated incoming content into an existing unsent composer?
rationale: This adds a new exported platform entry point and establishes user-visible warm-draft merge semantics; the linked canonical issue is already marked as needing product direction.

options.title: Sponsor after repair

options.title: Narrow the first version
options.body: Initially support cold text and single-image shares while deferring repeated warm-share merging.

options.title: Decline the target
options.body: Keep content selection inside the Android app and close the linked feature pair.
